review:
God of Wealth Hold And Win is a 25-line slot starring Caishen, the Chinese god of wealth. Three scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 award five free spins, during which a 3x3 giant symbol (worth nine identical symbols) can appear, and a giant scatter adds three more spins.

Six or more coins, each carrying a 1x to 100x multiplier, activate the Hold & Win feature in the base game or free spins. Mini, Major and Mega jackpots are available. The game's page lists a 2,000x maximum multiplier, but notes the jackpot can reach up to 10,000x the bet. BGaming rates it very high volatility, and the RTP is 95.24%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
